title: Retry a capture the gateway failed instead of leaving the order to the abandoned sweep
description: A Cardflow timeout or 5xx during capture fails the request with a 502 today and leaves the order `placed` for the abandoned sweep to cancel a day later, so a few minutes of gateway trouble costs us every order placed in them. Now the request keeps the order `placed`, queues a retry and answers 202 with it; the storefront already reads the order back until it is `paid`, so nothing changes on its side. A third sweep, `capture-retries`, runs every minute (`CAPTURE_RETRY_SWEEP_MS`) and captures again for every retry that has come due, through the same gateway with the same merchant reference, so Cardflow's idempotency key keeps a first attempt that landed late from charging twice. A capture that succeeds moves the order to `paid` and queues the pack job and the confirmation exactly as a fresh order does — that step is pulled out of `createOrder` as `applyCapture` so there is one of it; a decline cancels; another gateway error waits out the next step of the backoff (one, five, thirty minutes), and a failure on the third attempt cancels the order with a log line. The card token rides on the retry rather than the order, so it is gone once the gateway has answered. The retry queue is in-process behind a `RetryQueue` interface like the store and the job queue, and `packhouse stuck` lists the retries due beside the abandoned and stuck orders. The order never leaves `placed` while it waits, so the abandoned sweep's day-old cutoff still applies to it as before.

commit.subject: Retry a capture the gateway failed
commit.body:
A GatewayError from capture no longer fails POST /orders: the order stays
placed, a retry goes on the new RetryQueue and the request answers 202.
The capture-retries sweep drains due retries through the same gateway on a
1/5/30 minute backoff, then cancels. applyCapture extracted from
createOrder so a retried capture continues into packing the same way.

mustName: a gateway error during capture queues a retry instead of failing the request
the scheduler drains due retries with backoff
a retry that succeeds continues into packing exactly as a fresh order does
the order stays placed, where the abandoned sweep would still find it
expect.question: Where does a capture the gateway failed go now, and which existing parts still see the order while it waits?
